_comment: Read by `dotnet lambda deploy-function`. Committed so the deployment is one command and not a memory. Nothing here is a secret: the MCP endpoint is public and the skill id identifies a private, uncertified skill.
_role: Deliberately the same role the TypeScript bridge already uses. It grants basic execution and bedrock:InvokeModel on exactly one model, which is what this needs too — a second role would be a second thing to keep least-privileged.
function-description: A .NET backend for the same classic Alexa skill. Not Alexa+. Swap the ARN in the developer console to compare it with the TypeScript one.
